title: Refined small-parameter bound
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $\tau\in(0,1)$, $\epsilon\in(0,\tau/(1+\tau))$, $p_c\in(0,1/2)$, $p\ge0$, the biased minus-probability polynomial at $p_c$ equals $1/2$, and $p\le4(\tau/(1+\tau))^{1-\tau}\epsilon^{1+\tau}p_c$. Then the polynomial at $p$ is at most $\epsilon$.
